description:
A compliance crisis is unfolding at Pinnacle Healthcare Systems, one of Meridian Technology Partners' most critical accounts. You must take the following immediate actions:

1. The support ticket 'HIPAA audit finding - unencrypted backups' has been miscategorized. It is a life-or-death compliance issue — escalate it immediately: set Priority to 'Urgent' and Severity to 'Critical'. Also update the ticket Status to 'In Progress' to indicate active remediation has begun.

2. The associated deal 'Pinnacle EHR Security Upgrade' must be updated to reflect the negotiation impact of this incident. Change the sales stage to 'Negotiation/Review', set probability to 75, and update the expected close date to 2026-05-31 (the compliance deadline was pushed back).

3. Schedule an emergency remediation meeting with the Pinnacle account: create a new Meeting event with Subject 'HIPAA Emergency Remediation - Pinnacle Healthcare', date 2026-03-15, start time 09:00, end time 11:00, Status 'Planned', Location 'Video Conference - Zoom'. Link it to the Pinnacle Healthcare Systems account.

Login credentials: admin / password. Vtiger CRM is at http://localhost:8000
